claims.text: Acanthamoeba: epithelial debridement + 3–4 mo antiamoebic Tx
claims.quote: Treatment of Acanthamoeba keratitis and corneal ulcers generally involves epithelial debridement and 3 to 4 months of antiamoebic therapy.
Diamidines and biguanides are 2 classes of antiemetics often utilized as first-line therapy for AK due to their proven cysticidal effects.
